author: UpstateNYer
attribution: Photo: UpstateNYer, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:CocoCaySign.JPG. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Diamond-shaped painted welcome sign at the entrance of Coco Cay (Little Stirrup Cay), with palm and lighthouse silhouettes; stylised serif lettering, 'COCO' in capitals and 'Cay' with lower-case a and y. Distractor: a 'COCO CAY' T-shirt on a passer-by, and a small directional board behind. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: User:B
attribution: Photo: User:B, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Sandals_Island_entrance_sign.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Gable sign over a red entrance arch at the Sandals side of Discovery Island off Nassau (camera 25.0902, -77.4047). 'Sandals' is a raised brush-script logo; 'ISLAnd' is hand-lettered with capital I S L A and lower-case n d, transcribed as written. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

attribution: Photo: unknown, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:The_Island_School_-_Cape_Eleuthera_-_Bahamas.jpg. License: http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Tiled school sign with a mosaic fish, Cape Eleuthera; 'THE ISLAND SCHOOL' is set in an arch in a playful font, 'CAPE ELEUTHERA' is small below the fish. Seen from a moderate distance among palms.
source_title: File:The Island School - Cape Eleuthera - Bahamas.jpg

author: BrokenSphere
attribution: Photo: BrokenSphere, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Double_Dragon_Restaurant_sign,_Nassau.JPG. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Projecting restaurant sign in Nassau, seen from below. Traditional Chinese characters sit in the four corners: top 雙 (left) 龍 (right) = 'Double Dragon', bottom 酒 (left) 家 (right) = 'restaurant'. English name in a chop-suey style font. Rust streaks from the screws.

author: BrokenSphere
attribution: Photo: BrokenSphere, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Manila_Restaurant_sign,_Nassau.JPG. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hand-stencilled wooden board hanging from a blue beam in front of trees, Nassau; red stencil letters with bridges. The colon after FOOD is a stencilled '=' shape.

author: Steve-and-Jana
attribution: Photo: Steve-and-Jana, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Laughing_Lizard_Cafe_Sign_Gregory_Town_Eleuthera_2013.JPG. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hand-painted roadside sign with a green lizard, Gregory Town, Eleuthera. The name is painted 'Lisard' (with s, as written; the cafe is the Laughing Lizard). 'ART GALLERY' runs vertically on the left post board. Opening-hours boards below: 'TUE-SAT', '9ISH - 4ISH' (ISH in small caps).
source_title: File:Laughing Lizard Cafe Sign Gregory Town Eleuthera 2013.JPG

author: Pietro
attribution: Photo: Pietro, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:LucayanNationalParkSign.JPG. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Green carved park entrance sign on two posts, Grand Bahama; the Bahamas National Trust crest at left has 'BAHAMAS' around the top and 'NATIONAL TRUST' around the bottom (curved, small).

author: cogdogblog
attribution: Photo: cogdogblog, CC0 1.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:One_Room_School_House_(3426271870).jpg. License: http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/deed.en. Unmodified original.
notes: Roadside school sign with the Bahamas coat of arms at the top, Staniel Cay, Exumas; the school building and bicycles are behind. Motto line has no space after the comma ('Discipline,Work').

notes: Green park sign on two wooden posts, shot steeply from below against the sky (perspective skew), Shroud Cay. 'AND' is in small caps between LAND and SEA. Bahamas National Trust crest at left with curved small text. A tiny sponsor plaque on the left post is not transcribed.
